payload.claim: `_REGULAR_FILE_MODES = frozenset({"100644", "100755"})` restates the value of `saffron/repos/mirror.py`'s `_REGULAR_MODES = {"100644", "100755"}` (used there at mirror.py:251 and :261 for the identical regular-file-mode check) instead of importing it. Per the one-source rule this is a restated constant even though the two values agree today; if git mode handling for regular files ever needs a third mode or a submodule exception, only one of the two copies might be updated.
